identity.name: Thorn Whetstone
identity.summary: A long gray sharpening stone wrapped with a green bramble.
identity.description: Retaliates for 1 piercing damage per enemy strike. Each orthogonally touching weapon gains +2 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
identity.lore: The edge it sharpens is never quite the one expected.

effects.description: Retaliates for 1 piercing damage per enemy strike. Each orthogonally touching weapon gains +2 damage. Each source applies once per target, regardless of shared edges; distinct sources stack.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

empowerment.stacking: once per distinct source and target; different sources add
conditions: Both source and target are equipped.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Hedgehog Charm, Rusty Knife into Thorn Whetstone.
